summary: The audit counts your courses toward the 65 units the major needs, at least 50 of them in ANTHRO. ANTHRO 90B and 91 need a B or better. The emphasis is 20 units (C or better) from the three emphasis lists, 10 of them numbered 100 or above, and the rest is any ANTHRO courses, with at most 10 units of research coursework. At most 5 units of ANTHRO and 5 units from other departments taken S/NC count. Petitioned courses from related fields, overseas study or transfer (up to 15 units) are moved in by hand, and you check the C average in the major by hand. Honors needs the research courses, an A- in ANTHRO 95B and the GPAs. Left: the Bulletin also lists a "Method and Evidence Foreign Language requirement" without saying what it asks; ask the department.
